label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or governing body Y.
scope_notes: President, head, leader, chair, director, chief, executive, commissioner and equivalent organizational office qualify, including leadership within Y. Founder, partner, reporter, generic membership, location and athletic leads alone do not; historical tenure counts.

facts.reason: Samuel D. Waksal is explicitly executive, president and chief of ImClone Systems; founding is a distinct additional role.
Carleton S. Fiorina is described as executive and chairwoman of Hewlett-Packard; being ousted is compatible with prior tenure.
The direct director-at row connects Raymond W. Stone to a leadership role at McCarthy Research Associates; the second malformed extension does not remove that support.
Repeated leader-of and chairman descriptions establish Yasir Arafat leading the Palestine Liberation Organization.
John C. Bogle is explicitly chairman and executive of Vanguard Group in addition to its founder.
